title: Connected Components
summary: Group the nodes of an undirected graph into its connected components.
statement:
An undirected graph has `n` nodes numbered `0` to `n - 1`, and a list of `edges` where each entry [a, b] joins those two nodes. Return its connected components: one list of node numbers per component.

The nodes *within* each component must be in ascending order. The components themselves may come back in any order - the grader compares them as a set.

### Constraints

- 1 ≤ n ≤ 2,000
- 0 ≤ edges.length ≤ 5,000
- An isolated node is a component of size one
- Edges may repeat, and the graph may be disconnected

> **Stuck?**
>
> Read this [Graph Theory](/tutorials) tutorial.

visibleTests.explanation: With no edges, every node is its own component.
A cycle is still one component. Do not revisit nodes.
